note: Rules of tools/wbs.mjs (docs/eras/spec/VF.md 3.22). WP granularity per class: expected rows = eras x ceil(count x wpsPerItem x (1 + reserve) / itemsPerWp), compared with the number of wbs.csv rows whose wp id matches `match`, within `tolerance`. WP ids follow the convention UNIT-H-<ERA>-nn (humanoid units, 4 per WP), UNIT-X-<ERA>-nn (vehicles, mechs, bosses, siege, aliens: 1 per WP), PROP-<ERA>-nn (6 per batch), ARENA-<ERA>-nn, MISSION-<ERA>-nn, PUZZLE-<ERA>-nn (2 per WP), TEXT-<ERA>-<layer> (one per writer WP, +20% rewrite reserve), AUDIO-<ERA>-<family group> (4 families per WP), RIG-<rig>-TRACER|CLIPS|REACT (3 WPs per rig). <ERA> is MED, MOD or SF. A class whose manifest count is null is reported PENDING: set the count when the rosters are machine-readable (era manifests, registry phase P1); counts known from plan section 1 are filled in.
